RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel increases the risk of unconscious or affinity bias and may breach civil service diversity policies, but it is not conclusive proof of discrimination. The appointed candidate also presented credible, relevant qualifications. 

Alleging sex discrimination prematurely can damage your professional standing. First, follow up firmly on your written feedback request and ask to see the scoring matrix and recruitment diversity guidelines. If the response reveals procedural breaches, inconsistent criteria, or unexplained scoring gaps, raise the panel composition through your union or internal grievance channels. If the process followed standard protocols and the scores are well-substantiated, it is usually best not to pursue a formal dispute.
